sources.citation: Walter Mischel, Ebbe B. Ebbesen (1970). Attention in delay of gratification. Journal of Personality and Social Psychology.
sources.notes: Foundational primary study (1970) in Journal of Personality and Social Psychology establishing the core experimental paradigm and quantitative parameters.

sources.citation: B. J. Casey, Leah H. Somerville, Ian H. Gotlib, Ozlem Ayduk et al. (2011). Behavioral and neural correlates of delay of gratification 40 years later. Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences.
sources.notes: 40-year longitudinal fMRI follow-up of original Bing Nursery School participants linking inferior frontal control versus ventral striatal reactivity.

sources.citation: Walter Mischel, David Brooks (2011). The News From Psychological Science. Perspectives on Psychological Science.
sources.notes: Subsequent empirical and theoretical investigation (2011) in Perspectives on Psychological Science extending the foundational findings.

sources.citation: Tyler W. Watts, Greg J. Duncan, Haonan Quan (2018). Revisiting the Marshmallow Test: A Conceptual Replication Investigating Links Between Early Delay of Gratification and Later Outcomes. Psychological Science.
sources.notes: Large-scale 900-child conceptual replication controlling for family socioeconomic background and early cognitive ability.

sources.citation: Ozlem Ayduk, Rodolfo Mendoza-Denton (2019). Walter Mischel (1930–2018). American Psychologist.
sources.notes: Subsequent empirical and theoretical investigation (2019) in American Psychologist extending the foundational findings.

sources.citation: Armin Falk, Fabian Kosse, Pia Pinger (2020). Re-Revisiting the Marshmallow Test: A Direct Comparison of Studies by Shoda, Mischel, and Peake (1990) and Watts, Duncan, and Quan (2018). Psychological Science.
sources.notes: Subsequent empirical and theoretical investigation (2020) in Psychological Science extending the foundational findings.
